name: Halgar's Summons
summary: A formal summons calls promising Forsaken warlocks to advanced training in Undercity. Carendin Halgar expects those who have reached a threshold in their craft to join him in the Magic Quarter, where dangerous Nether beings await.

sections.title: A Master's Notice
sections.body: Word of a warlock's control over basic fel energies travels from Brill or the Tirisfal wilderness to Undercity. Ageron Kargal, a senior practitioner who spots talent, sends notice to those who show promise. Carendin Halgar's summons marks a rare privilege and a perilous step in a warlock's training. Basic imps and petty curses no longer suffice.

sections.title: The Magic Quarter
sections.body: Carendin Halgar oversees warlock rites in Undercity's Magic Quarter, near the Temple of the Damned. Forsaken darkcasters lack the living's moral restraint, but planar summonings still demand discipline. Halgar tolerates neither hesitation nor sentimentality. Those called to him are expected to show deference and be ready to face the hostile horrors of the Twisting Nether.

faq.answer: Carendin Halgar is the chief warlock trainer in Undercity's Magic Quarter. He oversees the dark development of Forsaken summoners and tests their resolve before teaching them to bind powerful Nether creatures.
Ageron Kargal, an established warlock trainer stationed in Brill, sends you after learning that Master Halgar has taken a personal interest in your progress.

faq.q: Where can I find Carendin Halgar in Undercity?
faq.answer: Halgar is in Undercity's Magic Quarter, near the dark dais called the Temple of the Damned.

aliases: why do i need this quest
what does halgars summons lead to
faq.answer: The summons marks your passage from basic spellcasting to dangerous demonic subjugation. It begins the trials required to bind a Voidwalker to your service.

faq.q: Is Halgar willing to teach anyone?
faq.answer: Halgar gives his attention to promising warlocks. He has little time for idle pleasantries and expects any apprentice brought before him to have proven capable with volatile fel arts.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Halgar?
faq.answer: When you report to Halgar, he tests your magic by assigning you to gather the components needed to summon and bind an otherworldly shadow minion.

angles.text: As a warlock, you pass from elementary training to planar enslavement under the scrutiny of Undercity's foremost master of the dark arts.
As Forsaken, you pursue shadow and fel with ruthless ambition. Halgar's sanctum reflects your people's practical disregard for the caution of the living.
